M-50x AHU CONTROLS SCHEMATIC AND SEQUENCE (pdf#56) and AHU POINTS LIST (pdf#57): a multi-zone VAV unit serving VAV boxes; supply array SF-1..6 and return array RF-1..4 on VFDs; the return array holds a return airflow of total supply airflow minus the minimum ventilation airflow (measured, AFM-1/AFM-4); the relief damper AE-1 holds the return fan plenum pressure (not building pressure); a ventilation damper AE-3 modulates to the minimum ventilation airflow (AFM-2) beside the economizer damper AE-4; economizer by comparative dew point against return air; chilled water coil (no DX); low limit freezestats hardwired to fan shutdown with a monitored status (LLT-1); duct smoke detectors by Division 28 through the fire alarm relay (no BAS point). A DOE laboratory (no UFC table).
